title: eval-harness: add per-prompt quality gating and CI metrics integration
author: Avery Chen
description: Add per-prompt quality gating to the eval-harness CI so that prompt-set regressions can block merges. Motivation: teams have increasingly relied on per-prompt metrics to catch localized regressions post-model-updates; current CI only exposes aggregate deltas which hide prompt-specific failures. This PR introduces a configurable gating layer driven by eval metrics (accuracy, hallucination score, and response-format pass rate) that runs as a pre-merge CI hook and reports detailed failures. Implementation includes: 1) new per_prompt_gate config with thresholds; 2) a CI hook that computes per-prompt deltas against baseline and fails if thresholds are exceeded for N prompts; 3) integration with the existing eval-metrics exporter so metrics are stored and surfaced in CI logs; 4) lightweight JS/TS and Python shims so the gating logic can be executed in different CI runners; 5) unit and integration tests; 6) docs and a migration guide for existing projects. Checklist: - [x] Design and config documented - [x] Metrics integration implemented - [x] Tests added (unit + integration) - [x] CI job defined and added to pipeline - [x] Rollout plan and feature flag (disabled by default) - [x] Release notes prepared

notes_for_operators: Operational considerations: the gating job fetches baseline metrics from the metrics backend; ensure credentials for metrics export are available to CI runner. Caching reduces load but requires careful TTL tuning. Enabling the gate in enterprise deployments requires config sync across private control planes. Rollout recommendation: start in report-only mode for two weeks, then enable soft-fail (annotate PRs), then enable hard-fail.
